title_zh: 亞什特 第 15 首‧瓦尤讚（風神讚）
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 23 卷，1883；公有領域

(pa nãm i ýazdã, hôrmezd i hvadâe
i awazûnî gurz hvarahe awazâyât,
mainyô râm bê rasât,
 ezh hamâ gunâh ... pa patit hôm!) 
xshnaothra ahurahe mazdå, tarôidîti angrahe
mainyêush, haithyâvarshtãm hyat vasnâ

ashem vohû...(3).
fravarâne mazdayasnô zarathushtrish vîdaêvô
ahura-tkaêshô,
segments.en:
May Ahura Mazda be rejoiced!....
Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
I confess myself a worshipper of Mazda, a follower of Zarathushtra,
one who hates the Daevas, and obeys the laws of Ahura;
For sacrifice, prayer, propitiation, and glorification unto [Havani]
the holy and master of holiness....
Unto Rama Hvastra, unto Vayu who works highly and is more powerful
to afflict than all other creatures,
Be propitiation from me, for sacrifice, prayer, propitiation and
glorification.
Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness....
segments.zh:
願阿胡拉‧馬茲達喜樂！....
阿舍姆‧沃胡：聖潔是一切善事中最好的....
我自認是馬茲達的崇拜者，是查拉圖斯特拉的追隨者，
誰憎恨達埃瓦，並服從阿胡拉的律法；
為了獻祭、禱告、安撫和讚美〔哈瓦尼〕
聖潔者及聖潔之主....
致羅摩‧瓦斯特拉，致瓦尤，其工作崇高且力量更大
使受苦過於所有其他生物，
願成為我的供獻，為祭祀、禱告、供獻與
讚美。
亞舍‧阿胡‧瓦伊羅：主的意志是聖潔的律法....

segments.orig:
ýazâi apemca bakhemca
ýazâi âxshtîm hãm-vaiñtîmca
suyãmca kataremcit,
tem vaêmcit ýazamaide
tem vaêmcit zbayamahi
ahmâica nmânâi ahmâica nmânahe nmânô-patêe
ahmâica zaothrô-barâi aredrâi paiti-asti
gêush vacahyeheca hathravataheca paiti hamerethanãm
vahishtem ýazatem ýazamaide.
segments.en:
I will sacrifice to the Waters and to Him who divides them.
I will sacrifice to Peace, whose breath is friendly, and to Weal,
both of them.
To this Vayu do we sacrifice, this Vayu do we invoke, for this
house, for the master of this house, and for the man here who
is offering libations and giving gifts. To this excellent God
do we sacrifice, that he may accept our meat and our prayers,
and grant us in return to crush our enemies at one stroke.
segments.zh:
我要獻祭給諸水，並獻祭給那分開諸水者。
我要獻祭給和平，其氣息友善，並獻祭給福祉，兩者皆是。
我們向這瓦尤獻祭，我們呼喚這瓦尤，
為這屋宅，為這屋宅之主，並為此處這獻上澆祭與贈予禮物之人。
我們向這卓越的神獻祭，願他接納我們的肉食與祈禱，
並回賜我們一舉擊潰我們的敵人。

segments.orig:
tem ýazata ýô dadhvå ahurô
mazdå airyene vaêjahi vanghuyå dâityayå
zaranaêne paiti gâtvô zaranaêne paiti
fraspâiti zaranaêne paiti upasterene frasteretât
paiti baresmen perenêbyô paiti khzhârayatbyô.
segments.en:
To him did the Maker, Ahura Mazda, offer up a sacrifice in
the Airyana Vaejah, on a golden throne, under golden beams and
a golden canopy, with bundles of baresma and offerings of full-boiling
[milk].
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主，阿胡拉‧馬茲達，在艾里亞納‧瓦埃賈，
於金色寶座之上，金色光芒之下，金色華蓋之下，
以成束的巴雷斯馬與沸騰的〔奶〕祭品，向他獻祭。

segments.orig:
aom jaidhyat,
avat âyaptem dazdi-mê
vayush ýô uparô-kairyô
ýatha azem nijanâni
angrahe mainyêush dâmanãm
naêcish avat ýô speñtahe.
segments.en:
He begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant me this, O Vayu! who
dost work highly, that I may smite the creation of Angra Mainyu,
and that nobody may smite this creation of the Good Spirit!'
segments.zh:
他向他祈求一恩賜，說：「請賜予我此願，啊，行高遠之事的瓦尤！
願我能擊殺安格拉‧曼紐的造物，
且願無人能擊殺這善靈的造物！」

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi tat avat âyaptem vayush ýô
uparô-kairyô ýatha tâ upanghacat ýô
dadhvå ahurô mazdå.
segments.en:
Vayu, who works highly, granted him that boon, as the Maker,
Ahura Mazda, did pursue it.
segments.zh: 行高遠之事的瓦尤，賜予他那恩賜，正如物質世界的造主阿胡拉‧馬茲達所求。

segments.en:
We sacrifice to the holy Vayu: we sacrifice to Vayu, who works
highly.
To this part of thee do we sacrifice, O Vayu! that belongs to
Spenta Mainyu.
For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto him a sacrifice
worth being heard, namely, unto the awful Vayu, who works highly.
We offer up a sacrifice unto the awful Vayu, who works highly,
with the libations, with the Haoma and meat, with the baresma,
with the wisdom of the tongue, with the holy spells, the words,
the deeds, the libations, and the well-spoken words.
Yenhe hatam: All those beings of whom Ahura Mazda....
segments.zh:
我們獻祭給聖潔的瓦尤：我們獻祭給瓦尤，他工作
高度地。
我們獻祭給你的這部分，哦，瓦尤！那是屬於
斯彭塔‧曼紐。
因為他的光亮與榮耀，我將向他獻上祭祀。
值得被聽見，也就是說，獻給可怕的瓦尤，他工作高度。
我們獻上祭祀給可怕的瓦尤，誰工作極高，
與祭酒，與豪麻和肉，與巴爾斯瑪，
與舌頭的智慧，與聖咒，話語，
行為，祭酒，以及說得好的話語。
Yenhe hatam: 所有阿胡拉‧馬茲達所屬的眾生....

on a golden throne, under golden beams and a golden canopy, with
bundles of baresma and offerings of full-boiling [milk].
segments.zh: 塔赫瑪‧烏魯帕，善持武器者，向他獻上祭品。於黃金寶座之上，於黃金橫梁之下，於黃金天篷之下，以成束的巴爾斯曼枝，並以滿溢沸騰〔的牛奶〕為供品。

aom jaidhyat,
avat âyaptem dazdi-mê
vayush ýô uparô-kairyô
ýat bavâni aiwi-vanyå

framitem aspahe kehrpa
thrisatem aiwi-gâmanãm

segments.en:
He begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant me this, O Vayu! who
dost work highly, that I may conquer all Daevas and men, all the
Yatus and Pairikas, and that I may ride Angra Mainyu, turned into
the shape of a horse, all around the earth from one end to the
other, for thirty years.'
segments.zh: 他向他祈求一恩賜，說道：「請賜予我此恩賜，啊，行事崇高的瓦尤！使我得以征服所有達埃瓦與凡人，所有亞圖與帕伊里卡；並使我得以騎乘化為馬形的安格拉‧曼紐，環繞整個大地，從一端到另一端，達三十年之久。」

tem ýazata ýô ýimô xshaêtô
hvãthwô
hukairyât haca barezanghat

segments.en:
Unto him did the bright Yima, the good shepherd, sacrifice
from the height Hukairya, the all-shining and golden, on a golden
throne, under golden beams and a golden canopy, with bundles of
baresma and offerings of full-boiling [milk].
segments.zh: 光輝的伊瑪，善良的牧者，從胡凱里亞高峰，那全光輝而金黃的山峰上，向他獻上祭品。於黃金寶座之上，於黃金橫梁之下，於黃金天篷之下，以成束的巴爾斯曼枝，並以滿溢沸騰〔的牛奶〕為供品。

segments.orig:
aom jaidhyat,
avat âyaptem dazdi-mê
vayush ýô uparô-kairyô
ýat bavâni hvarenanguhastemem zâtanãm
hvaredaresem mashyânãm
ýat kerenavâni mâvôya xshathrâdha
amareshañta pasu vîra
anghêushemne âpa urvaire
hvairyãn hvarethem ajyamnem,
ýimahe xshathre aurvahe
nôit aotem ångha nôit garemem
nôit zaurva ångha nôit merethyush
nôit araskô ýô daêvô-dâtô.
segments.en:
He begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant me this, O Vayu! who
dost work highly, that I may become the most glorious of the men
born to behold the sun: that I may make in my reign both animals
and men undying, waters and plants undrying, and the food for
eating creatures never-failing.'
In the reign of the valiant Yima there was neither cold wind nor
hot wind, neither old age nor death, nor envy made by the Daevas.
segments.zh: 他向他祈求一恩賜，說道：「請賜予我此恩賜，啊，行事崇高的瓦尤！使我得以成為生來得見太陽之人中最為光榮者；使我在我的統治期間，得以令牲畜與人類不死，令水與植物不枯，令可食生物的糧食永不匱乏。」在英勇的伊瑪統治期間，既無寒風，也無熱風；既無衰老，也無死亡；亦無達埃瓦所製造的嫉妒。

segments.orig:
tem ýazata azhish thrizafå dahâkô
upa kviriñtem duzhitem
zaranaêne paiti gâtvô zaranaêne paiti

segments.en:
Unto him did the three-mouthed Azhi Dahaka offer up a sacrifice
in his accursed palace of Kvirinta, on a golden throne, under
golden beams and a golden canopy, with bundles of baresma and
offerings of full-boiling [milk].
segments.zh: 三嘴的阿日‧達哈卡在他被詛咒的克維林塔宮殿內獻上祭品，坐在金座上，金梁和金蓋之下，攜帶巴爾斯瑪的束縛和滿沸[牛奶]的供品。

segments.orig:
aom jaidhyat,
avat âyaptem dazdi-mê
vayush ýô uparô-kairyô
ýatha azem amashyãn kerenavâni vîspâish
avi karshvãn ýâish hapta.
segments.en:
He begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant me this, O Vayu! who
dost work highly, that I may make all the seven Karshvares of
the earth empty of men.'
segments.zh: 他向他乞求恩典，說： '賜予我這個，奧瓦尤！你高超工作，使我能讓地球上的七個卡爾什瓦雷都沒有人。'

segments.orig:

nôit zbayañtâi nôit aredrâi nôit
zaothrô-barâi nôit ahmâi dathat tat avat

ahe raya hvarenanghaca

haomayô gava baresmana hizvô danghangha mãthraca

tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
In vain did he sacrifice, in vain did he beg, in vain did
he invoke, in vain did he give gifts, in vain did he bring libations;
Vayu did not grant him that boon.
For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto him a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh: 他徒然獻祭，他徒然乞求，他徒然呼喚，他徒然獻禮物，他徒然奉上祭酒；瓦尤沒有授予他這個恩典。為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽見的祭品....

1.)
segments.en:

segments.orig:
tem ýazata vîsô puthrô âthwyânôish
vîsô sûrayå thraêtaonô
upa varenem cathru-gaoshem
zaranaêne paiti gâtvô zaranaêne paiti
fraspâiti zaranaêne paiti upasterene frasteretât
paiti baresmen perenêbyô paiti khzhârayatbyô.
segments.en:
Unto him did Thraetaona, the heir of the valiant Athwya clan,
offer up a sacrifice in the four-cornered Varena, on a golden
throne, under golden beams and a golden canopy, with bundles of
baresma and offerings of full-boiling [milk].
segments.zh: 他向他獻上祭品的是斯拉埃陶納，勇敢的阿斯維亞族的繼承人，在四角的瓦雷納內，坐在金座上，金梁和金蓋之下，攜帶巴爾斯瑪的束縛和滿沸[牛奶]的供品。

He begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant me this, O Vayu! who
dost work highly, that I may overcome Azhi Dahaka, the three-mouthed,
the three-headed, the six-eyed, who has a thousand senses, that
most powerful, fiendish Druj, that demon baleful to the world,
the strongest Druj that Angra Mainyu created against the material
world, to destroy the world of the good principle; and that I
may deliver his two wives, Savanghavach and Erena-vach, who are
the fairest of body amongst women, and the most wonderful creatures
in the world.'
segments.zh:
他向他乞求一個恩典，說：「賜予我這個，哦，瓦尤！誰」
你工作極高，好讓我能戰勝阿日‧達哈卡，三張嘴的，
三頭的，六眼的，擁有千種感官的，那
最強大的，邪惡的德魯格，那對世界有害的惡魔，
最強的德魯格，是安格拉‧曼紐針對物質所創造的
世界，以毀滅善良原則的世界；以及我
可以拯救他的兩位妻子，薩萬加瓦赫和埃雷納-瓦赫，他們是
在女性中體態最美，而且是最奇妙的生物
在世界裡。

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
(Repeat verses 4-5.)
segments.en:
Vayu, who works highly, granted him that boon, as the Maker,
Ahura Mazda, did pursue it.
We sacrifice to the holy Vayu....
For his brightness and glory I will offer unto him a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh: 瓦尤，他高超工作，授予他這個恩典，正如造物主，阿胡拉‧馬茲達所追求的那樣。我們獻祭給聖潔的瓦尤.... 為了他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽見的祭品....

segments.orig:
ýazâi apemca ... ýazamaide. (Repeat verse
1.)
segments.en:
I will sacrifice to the Waters and to Him who divides them....
To this Vayu do we sacrifice, this Vayu do we invoke....
segments.zh: 我將獻祭給水域和那位分割它們的神.... 我們將獻祭給這位瓦尤，我們將呼喚這位瓦尤....

segments.orig:
tem ýazata naire-manå keresâspô
upa gudhem apakhzhârem
ranghayå mazdadhâtayå
zaranaêne paiti gâtvô zaranaêne paiti
fraspâiti zaranaêne paiti upasterene frasteretât
paiti baresmen perenêbyô paiti khzhârayatbyô.
segments.en:
To him did the manly-hearted Keresaspa offer up a sacrifice
by the Gudha, a channel of the Rangha, made by Mazda, upon a golden
throne, under golden beams and a golden canopy, with bundles of
baresma and offerings of full-boiling [milk].
segments.zh: 勇猛之心的凱雷薩斯帕，在蘭哈河那馬茲達所造的溝渠古達之畔，於金御座之上、金樑之下、金帳之內，以成捆的巴雷斯摩與滿沸〔乳〕之供品，向他獻祭。

segments.orig:
aom jaidhyat,
avat âyaptem dazdi-mê
vayush ýô uparô-kairyô
ýat kaêna nijasâni
azem brâthrô urvâxshaya
ýat janâni hitâspem
raithe paiti vazaidhyâi,
uiti asti gafyô âhûirish uiti aêvô
gafyô paitish uiti gañdarewô upâpô.
segments.en:
He begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant me this, O Vayu! who
dost work highly, that I may succeed in avenging my brother Urvakhshaya,
that I may smite Hitaspa and yoke him to my chariot.'
The Gandarewa, who lives beneath the waters, is the son of Ahura
in the deep, he is the only master of the deep.
segments.zh:
他向他祈求一恩賜，說道：「請賜予我這個，瓦尤啊！你行事崇高，使我得以成功報我兄弟烏爾瓦赫沙亞之仇，使我得以擊打希塔斯帕，並將他套上我的戰車。」
那生於水下的甘達雷瓦，是深淵中阿胡拉的兒子，他是深淵唯一的主人。

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
(Repeat verses 4-5.)
segments.en:
Vayu, who works highly, granted him that boon, as the Maker,
Ahura Mazda, did pursue it.
We sacrifice to the holy Vayu....
For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto him a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh:
行事崇高的瓦尤，賜予他那恩賜，正如造主阿胡拉‧馬茲達所追尋的那樣。
我們向神聖的瓦尤獻祭……
為了他的光明與榮耀，我將向他獻上值得聆聽的祭品……

segments.orig:
ýazâi apemca ... ýazamaide. (Repeat verse
1.)
segments.en:
I will sacrifice to the Waters and to Him who divides them....
To this Vayu do we sacrifice, this Vayu do we invoke....
segments.zh:
我將向諸水與那分水者獻祭……
我們向這瓦尤獻祭，我們呼喚這瓦尤……

segments.orig:
tem ýazata
aurvasârô dainghupaitish
avi spaêtinish razurå
upa spaêititem razurem
upa vimaidhem razuraya
zaranaêne paiti gâtvô zaranaêne paiti
fraspâiti zaranaêne paiti upasterene frasteretât
paiti baresmen perenêbyô paiti khzhârayatbyô.
segments.en:
To him did Aurvasara, the lord of the country, offer up a
sacrifice, towards the White Forest, by the White Forest, on the
border of the White Forest, on a golden throne, under golden beams
and a golden canopy, with bundles of baresma and offerings of
full-boiling [milk].
segments.zh: 奧爾瓦薩拉，那國土之主，向白森林、在白森林之旁、於白森林的邊界上，於金御座之上、金樑之下、金帳之內，以成捆的巴雷斯摩與滿沸〔乳〕之供品，向他獻祭。

segments.orig:
aom jaidhyat,
avat âyaptem dazdi-mê
vayush ýô uparô-kairyô
ýat nâ nôit nijanât
arsha airyanãm dah'yunãm
xshathrâi hañkeremô haosrava,
ýatha azem uzayeni
haca kavôish haosravanghahe,
janât tem kava haosrava
vîspe aire razuraya.
segments.en:
He begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant me this, O Vayu! who
dost work highly, that the gallant Husravah, he who unites the
Aryan nations into one kingdom, may not smite us; that I may flee
from king Husravah;....
'That king Husravah and all the Aryans in the forest may smite
him.'
segments.zh:
他向他祈求一恩賜，說道：「請賜予我這個，瓦尤啊！你行事崇高，使那英勇的胡斯拉瓦——他將雅利安諸族統一於一王國之下——不得擊打我們；使我得以逃離胡斯拉瓦王；……
『願胡斯拉瓦王與森林中所有雅利安人擊打他。』」

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
(Repeat verses 4-5.)
segments.en:
Vayu, who works highly, granted him that boon, as the Maker,
Ahura Mazda, did pursue it.
We sacrifice to the holy Vayu....
For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto him a sacrifice
Worth being heard....
segments.zh:
行事崇高的瓦尤，賜予他那恩賜，正如造主阿胡拉‧馬茲達所追尋的那樣。
我們向神聖的瓦尤獻祭……
為了他的光明與榮耀，我將向他獻上值得聆聽的祭品……

segments.orig:
ýazâi apemca ... ýazamaide. (Repeat verse
1.)
segments.en:
I will sacrifice to the Waters and to Him who divides them....
To this Vayu do we sacrifice, this Vayu do we invoke....
segments.zh:
我將向諸水與那分水者獻祭……
我們向這瓦尤獻祭，我們呼喚這瓦尤……

segments.orig:
tem ýazata
hutaosa ýâ pouru-brâthra
vîsô avi naotaranãm
zaranaêne paiti gâtvô zaranaêne paiti
fraspâiti zaranaêne paiti upasterene frasteretât
paiti baresmen perenêbyô paiti khzhârayatbyô.
segments.en:
To him did Hutaosa, she of the many brothers, of the Naotara
house, offer up a sacrifice, on a golden throne, under golden
beams and a golden canopy, with bundles of baresma and offerings
of boiling milk.
segments.zh: 他受到胡塔奧薩的祭獻，她是眾多兄弟之人，來自納奧塔拉家，在金座上，在金梁與金蓋之下，帶著巴爾斯瑪束與沸騰牛奶的供品獻上。

segments.orig:
aom jaidhyat,
avat âyaptem dazdi-mê
vayush ýô uparô-kairyô
ýat bavâni frya fritha paiti-zañta
nmâne kavôish vîshtâspahe.
segments.en:
She begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant me this, O Vayu!
who dost work highly, that I may be dear and loved and well-received
in the house of King Vishtaspa.'
segments.zh: 她向他乞求恩典，說：『賜予我這個，哦，瓦尤！你行事崇高，使我在維什塔斯帕王的家中被親愛、被愛戴、受歡迎。』

segments.orig:
dathat ahmâi ... tåscâ ýazamaide!
(Repeat verses 4-5.)
segments.en:
Vayu, who works highly, granted her that boon, as the Maker,
Ahura Mazda, did pursue it.
We sacrifice to the holy Vayu....
For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto him a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh: 瓦尤，行事崇高，授予她這個恩典，正如造物主阿胡拉‧馬茲達所追求的那樣。我們獻祭給聖潔的瓦尤。……因他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽見的祭獻。……

segments.orig:
ýazâi apemca ... ýazamaide. (Repeat verse
1.)
segments.en:
I will sacrifice to the Waters and to Him who divides them....
To this Vayu do we sacrifice, this Vayu do we invoke....
segments.zh: 我將獻祭給水域以及分割水域之者。……我們將祭獻給這位瓦尤，我們將呼喚這位瓦尤。……

segments.orig:
tem ýazeñta kainina ýôi anupaêta
mashyânãm zaranaêne paiti gâtvô
zaranaêne paiti fraspâiti zaranaêne paiti upasterene
frasteretât paiti baresmen perenêbyô paiti khzhârayatbyô.
segments.en:
To him did the maids, whom no man had known, offer up a sacrifice
on a golden throne, under golden beams and a golden canopy, with
bundles of baresma and offerings of boiling milk.
segments.zh: 他受到那些未曾被任何男子認識的少女們的祭獻，在金座上，在金梁與金蓋之下，帶著巴爾斯瑪束與沸騰牛奶的供品獻上。

segments.orig:
âat hîm jaidhyen,
avat âyaptem dazdi-nô
vayush ýô uparô-kairyô
ýat nmânô-paitîm viñdâma
ývânô sraêshtô-kehrpa
ýô nô huberetãm barât
ýavata gaya jvâva
frazaiñtîmca hô verezyât
dangrô dañtô hizuxdhô.
segments.en:
They begged of him a boon, saying: 'Grant us this, O Vayu!
who dost work highly, that we may find a husband, young and beautifuI
of body, who will treat us well, all life long, and give us offspring;
a wise, learned, ready-tongued husband.'
segments.zh: 他們向他乞求恩典，說：『賜予我們這個，哦，瓦尤！你行事崇高，使我們能找到一位年輕、身體美好的丈夫，他會善待我們，終生不離，並給我們後代；一位智慧、學識豐富、言語敏捷的丈夫。』

segments.orig:
dathat aibyascit tat avat âyaptem ... tåscâ
ýazamaide! (cf. verses 4-5.)
segments.en:
Vayu, who works highly, granted them that boon, as the Maker,
Ahura Mazda, did pursue it.
We sacrifice to the holy Vayu....
For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto him a sacrifice
worth being heard....
segments.zh: 瓦尤，行事崇高，授予他們這個恩典，正如造物主阿胡拉‧馬茲達所追求的那樣。我們獻祭給聖潔的瓦尤。……因他的光輝與榮耀，我將獻上值得被聽見的祭獻。……

segments.orig:
ýazâi apemca ... ýazamaide, (Repeat verse
1.)
segments.en:
I will sacrifice to the Waters and to Him who divides them....
To this Vayu do we sacrifice, this Vayu do we invoke....
We sacrifice to that Vayu that belongs to the Good Spirit, the
bright and glorious Vayu.
segments.zh: 我將獻祭給水域以及分割水域之者。……我們將祭獻給這位瓦尤，我們將呼喚這位瓦尤。……我們獻祭給屬於善靈的那位瓦尤，這位光輝榮耀的瓦尤。

segments.orig:
vayush bâ nãma ahmi ashâum zarathushtra,
avat vayush bâ nãma ahmi ýat va dãma
vayemi ýasca dathat speñtô mainyush ýasca
dathat angrô mainyush, apayate nãma ahmi ashâum
zarathushtra avat apayate nãma ahmi ýat va dãma
apayemi ýasca dathat speñtô mainyush ýasca
dathat angrô mainyush.
segments.en:
My name is Vayu, O holy Zarathushtra! My name is Vayu, because
I go through (vyemi) the two worlds, the one which the Good Spirit
has made and the one which the Evil Spirit has made.
My name is the Overtaker (apaeta), O holy Zarathushtra! My name
is the Overtaker, because I can overtake the creatures of both
worlds, the one that the Good Spirit has made and the one that
the Evil Spirit has made.
segments.zh:
我的名字是瓦尤，哦，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！我的名字是瓦尤，因為我穿越（vyemi）兩個世界，一個是善靈所造的世界，一個是惡靈所造的世界。
我的名字是追趕者（apaeta），哦，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！我的名字是追趕者，因為我能追趕兩個世界的造物，一個是善靈所造的世界，一個是惡靈所造的世界。

segments.orig:
vanô-vîspå nãma ahmi ashâum
zarathushtra, avat vanô-vîspå nãma ahmi
ýat va dãma vanâmi ýasca dathat speñtô
mainyush ýasca dathat angrô mainyush, vohvarshte
nãma ahmi ashâum zarathushtra avat vohvarshte nãma
ahmi ýat vohû verezyâmi
dathushô ahurâi mazdâi
ameshanãm speñtanãm.
segments.en:
My name is the All-smiting, O holy Zarathushtra! My name is
the All-smiting, because I can smite the creatures of both worlds,
the one that the Good Spirit has made and the one that the Evil
Spirit has made.
My name is the Worker of Good, O holy Zarathushtra! My name is
the Worker of Good, because I work the good of the Maker, Ahura
Mazda and of the Amesha-Spentas.
segments.zh:
我的名字是全能打擊者，哦，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！我的名字是全能打擊者，因為我能打擊兩個世界的造物，一個是善靈所造的世界，一個是惡靈所造的世界。
我的名字是行善者，哦，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！我的名字是行善者，因為我為造主阿胡拉‧馬茲達和不朽聖者行善。

segments.orig:
fracare nãma ahmi aipicare nãma ahmi aipidhbaokhe
nãma ahmi fraspå nãma ahmi nispå nãma
ahmi dahake nãma ahmi zinake nãma ahmi vîdake
nãma ahmi viñdihvarene nãma ahmi
segments.en:
My name is He that goes forwards.
My name is He that goes backwards.
My name is He that bends backwards.
My name is He that hurls away.
My name is He that hurls down.
My name is He that destroys.
My name is He that takes away.
My name is He that finds out.
My name is He that finds out the Glory (Hvareno).
segments.zh:
我的名字是前進者。
我的名字是後退者。
我的名字是向後彎曲者。
我的名字是投擲者。
我的名字是拋下者。
我的名字是毀滅者。
我的名字是奪取者。
我的名字是發現者。
我的名字是發現榮耀（赫瓦雷諾）者。

segments.orig:
aurvô nãma ahmi aurvôtemô nãma
ahmi, taxmô nãma ahmi taxmôtema nãma
ahmi, derezrô nãma ahmi darejishtô nãma
ahmi, aoji nãma ahmi aojish nãma ahmi, hupairitå
nãma ahmi hupairispå nãma ahmi, hathravana
nãma ahmi âiniva nãma ahmi, vidhaêvô-kare
nãma ahmi karedarese nãma ahmi.
segments.en:
My name is the Valiant; my name is the Most Valiant.
My name is the Strong; my name is the Strongest.
My name is the Firm; my name is the Firmest.
My name is the Stout; my name is the Stoutest.
My name is He that crosses over easily.
My name is He that goes along hurling away.
My name is He that crushes at one stroke.
My name is (?Ainiva).
My name is He that works against the Daevas.
My name is (?Keredharisha).
segments.zh:
我的名字是勇敢者；我的名字是最勇敢者。
我的名字是強壯者；我的名字是最強壯者。
我的名字是堅定者；我的名字是最堅定者。
我的名字是剛毅者；我的名字是最剛毅者。
我的名字是輕易跨越者。
我的名字是邊走邊投擲者。
我的名字是一擊粉碎者。
我的名字是（?艾尼瓦）。
我的名字是對抗達埃瓦者。
我的名字是（?凱雷達雷舍）。

segments.orig:
tarô-tbaêshô nãma ahmi tbaêshô-tarô
nãma ahmi, âyaozô nãma ahmi pâyaozô
nãma ahmi vivaozô nãma ahmi, saocahi nãma
ahmi bucahi nãma ahmi, buxtish nãma ahmi saidhish
nãma ahmi, geredhô nãma ahmi geredhyaoxdhô
nãma ahmi geredhixavô nãma ahmi.
segments.en:
My name is He that prevails over malice; my name is He that
destroys malice.
My name is He that unites; my name is He that reunites; my name
is He that separates.
My name is the Burning; my name is the Quick of intelligence,
My name is Deliverance; my name is Welfare.
My name is the Burrow; my name is He who destroys the burrows;
my name is He who spits upon the burrows.
segments.zh:
我的名字是勝過惡意者；我的名字是毀滅惡意者。
我的名字是聯合者；我的名字是再聯合者；我的名字是分離者。
我的名字是燃燒者；我的名字是智慧敏捷者。
我的名字是解脫者；我的名字是福祉者。
我的名字是洞穴者；我的名字是毀滅洞穴者；我的名字是向洞穴吐唾沫者。

segments.orig:
tizhyarshte nãma ahmi tizhyarshtish nãma ahmi
perethvareshte nãma ahmi perethvareshtish nãma ahmi,
vaêzhyarshte nãma ahmi vaêzhyarshtish nãma
ahmi, hvarenå nãma ahmi aiwi-hvarenå nãma
ahmi.
segments.en:
My name is Sharpness of spear; my name is He of the sharp
spear.
My name is Length of spear; my name is He of the long spear.
My name is Piercingness of spear; my name is He of the piercing
spear.
My name is the Glorious; my name is the Over-glorious.
segments.zh:
我的名字是矛尖鋒利者；我的名字是擁有鋒利矛尖者。
我的名字是矛身長者；我的名字是擁有長矛身者。
我的名字是矛刺穿透者；我的名字是擁有穿透矛刺者。
我的名字是光榮者；我的名字是至光榮者。

segments.orig:
tåsca-mê nãma zbayaêsha ahmi ashâum
zarathushtra ýim añtare haênayå xrûishyeitish
añtare hãm-ýañta rasmaoyô
añtare dainghu pâperetâne.
segments.en:
Invoke these names of mine, O holy Zarathushtra! in the midst
of the havocking hordes, in the midst of the columns moving forwards,
in the strife of the conflicting nations.
segments.zh: 呼喚我的這些名字，哦，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！在浩劫的軍隊之中，在前進的縱隊之中，在衝突的諸民族爭鬥之中。

segments.orig:
tåsca-mê nãma zbayaêsha ahmi ashâum
zarathushtra ýim sâsta dainghêush hamô-xshathrô
pateñtem vâ zbareñtem vâ irisheñtem
vâ rathôishemnem vâ paitisheñtem thrimahe
paitisheñtem baêshazyehe.
segments.en:
Invoke these names of mine, O holy Zarathushtra! when the
all-powerful tyrant of a country falls upon thee, rushes upon
thee, deals wounds hpon thee, or hurls his chariot against thee,
to rob thee of thy wealth, to rob thee of thy health.
segments.zh: 呼喚我的這些名字，哦，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！當一個國家全權的暴君襲擊你，衝向你，對你造成傷害，或駕戰車向你衝來，要奪取你的財富，要奪取你的健康之時。

segments.orig:
tåsca-mê nãma zbayaêsha ahmi ashâum
zarathushtra ýim ashemaokhem anashavanem pateñtem
vâ zbareñtem vâ irisheñtem vâ
rathôishemnem vâ paitisheñtem amahe paitisheñtem
thrimahe paitisheñtem baêshazyehe.
segments.en:
Invoke these names of mine, O holy Zarathushtra! when the
unholy Ashemaogha falls upon thee, rushes upon thee, deals wounds
upon thee, or hurls his chariot against thee, to rob thee of thy
strength, to rob thee of thy health, to rob thee of thy health.
segments.zh: 請誦念我的這些名字，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！當不聖的阿舍瑪奧格降落在你身上，衝向你，對你造成傷口，或將他的戰車撞向你，以奪走你的力量，奪走你的健康，奪走你的健康。

segments.orig:
tåsca-mê nãma zbayaêsha ahmi ashâum
zarathushtra
ýat bastô anghat hishtemnô
bastô anghat frâdhayamnô
bastô anghat vâdhayamnô
fradhbaoye bâshe buyeñte
vidhbaoye grâfe buyeñte.
segments.en:
Invoke these names of mine, O holy Zarathushtra! when a man
stands in bonds, when a man is being thrown into bonds, or when
a man is being dragged in bonds: thus the prisoners flee from
the hands of those who carry them, they flee away out of the prison.
segments.zh: 請誦念我的這些名字，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！當一個人站在束縛中，當一個人被投入束縛，或當一個人被拖入束縛：因此囚犯從押送他們的人手中逃脫，他們逃離監獄。

segments.orig:
vayô aspaêshu vîraêshu vîspaêshu
vimanekare vîspaêshu vîdaêvô-kare
nitemaêshva gâtushva hazangrô-temahvaca hãm
isemnem paidhyâiti.
segments.en:
O thou Vayu! who strikest fear upon all men and horses, who
in all creatures workest against the Daevas, both into the lowest
places and into those a thousand times deep dost thou enter with
equal power.
segments.zh: 哦，瓦尤！誰讓所有男人和馬匹感到恐懼，誰在所有生物中對達埃瓦進行作用，你同樣以同等力量進入最低的地方以及深達千倍的地方。

segments.orig:
kana thwãm ýasna ýazâne
kana ýasna frâyazâne
kana thwâ ýasna paiti heñkereitish ava-hishtât
vayush aurvô uskât-ýâstô
derezi-ýaoxedhrô berezi-pâdhô
perethu-varô perethu-sraonish anâxrvidha-dôithre
ýatha anyåscit xshathrât xshayamnå hamô-xshathrô-xshayamnå.
segments.en:
'With what manner of sacrifice shall I worship thee? With
what manner of sacrifice shall I forward and worship thee? With
what manner of sacrifice will be achieved thy adoration, O great
Vayu! thou who art high-up g.rded, firm, swift-moving, high-footed,
wide-breasted, wide-thighed, with untrembling eyes, as powerful
in sovereignty as any absolute sovereign in the world?'
segments.zh: '我應該以何種祭祀方式來崇拜你？我應該以何種祭祀方式來前進並崇拜你？以何種祭祀方式才能實現對你的敬拜，哦，偉大的瓦尤！你這位高舉的、堅固的、快速移動的、腳部高的、胸闊的、腿闊的、眼睛不顫抖的，在主權方面與世界上任何絕對統治者同等強大。'

segments.orig:
tûm baresma ayasaêsha ashâum zarathushtra
fracinathware vicinathware raocinavañtem bâmîm
frataraêibyô raocå vîtaraêibyô
ushånghem.
segments.en:
'Take thou a baresma, O holy Zarathushtra! turn it upwards
or downwards, according as it is full day or dawning; upwards
during the day, downwards at the dawn.
segments.zh: '拿取一根巴爾斯瑪，聖潔的查拉圖斯特拉！根據是白天完整還是黎明，將其向上或向下轉動；白天時向上，黎明時向下。'

segments.orig:
ýezi mãm ýashtô kerenavâni
azem tê vaca framravâni mazdadhâta hvarenanghvañta
baêshazya ýatha thwãm nôit taurvayât
angrô mainyush pouru-mahrkô nôit ýâtô
nôit ýâtumå nôit daêvô
naêdha mashyô.
segments.en:
'If thou makest me worshipped with a sacrifice, then I shall
say unto thee with my own voice things of health, made by Mazda
and full of glory, so that Angra Mainyu may never do harm unto
thee, nor the Yatus, nor those addicted to the works of the Yatu,
whether Daevas or men.'
segments.zh: '如果你以祭祀讓我被崇拜，那我將用自己的聲音說出由馬茲達創造、充滿榮耀的健康事物，以便安格拉‧曼紐永遠不會對你造成傷害，也不會是耶圖斯，也不會是那些沉迷於耶圖工作的人，無論是達埃瓦還是人類。'

segments.orig:
vayô aurva ýazamaide, vayô taxma ýazamaide,
vaêm aurvanãm aurvôtemem ýazamaide,
vaêm taxmanãm taxmôtemem ýazamaide,
vaêm zaranyô-xaodhem ýazamaide, vaêm
zaranyô-pusem ýazamaide, vaêm zaranyô-minem
ýazamaide, vaêm zaranyô-vâshem ýazamaide,
vaêm zaranyô-caxrem ýazamaide, vaêm zaranyô-zaêm
ýazamaide, vaêm zaranyô-vastrem ýazamaide,
vaêm zaranyô-aothrem ýazamaide, vaêm
zaranyô-aiwyånghanem ýazamaide, vaêm
ashavanem ýazamaide, vaêm uparô-kairîm
ýazamaide, aêtat tê vayô ýazamaide
ýat tê asti speñtô-mainyaom.
ahe raya hvarenanghaca
tem ýazâi surunvata ýasna
ukhrem vaêm uparô-kairîm zaothrâbyô,
ukhrem vaêm uparô-kairîm ýazamaide
haomayô gava baresmana hizvô danghangha mãthraca
vacaca shyaothnaca zaothrâbyasca arshuxdhaêibyasca
vâkhzhibyô.
ýenghê hâtãm âat ýesnê
paitî vanghô mazdå ahurô vaêthâ
ashât hacâ ýånghãmcâ tãscâ
tåscâ ýazamaide!
segments.en:
We sacrifice unto thee, O great Vayu! we sacrifice unto thee,
O strong Vayu!
We sacrifice unto Vayu, the greatest of the great; we sacrifice
unto Vayu, the strongest of the strong.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden helm.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden crown.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden necklace.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden chariot.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden wheel.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden weapons.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden garment.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden shoe.
We sacrifice unto Vayu, of the golden girdle.
We sacrifice unto the holy Vayu; we sacrifice unto Vayu, who works
highly.
To this part of thee do we sacrifice, O Vayu! that belongs to
the Good Spirit.
For his brightness and glory, I will offer unto him a sacrifice
worth being heard, namely, unto the awful Vayu, who works highly....
segments.zh:
我們獻祭給你，偉大的瓦尤！我們獻祭給你，
強大的瓦尤！
我們獻祭給瓦尤，偉大中的偉大；我們獻祭
獻祭給瓦尤，強者中的最強。
我們獻祭給瓦尤，金盔。
我們獻祭給瓦尤，金冠。
我們獻祭給瓦尤，金項鍊。
我們獻祭給瓦尤，金戰車。
我們獻祭給瓦尤，金輪。
我們獻祭給瓦尤，金武器。
我們獻祭給瓦尤，金衣。
我們獻祭給瓦尤，金鞋。
我們獻祭給金腰帶的瓦尤。
我們獻祭給聖潔的瓦尤；我們獻祭給瓦尤，他工作
高度。
我們獻祭給你的這部分，哦瓦尤！那是屬於
因為他的亮度和榮耀，我會向他獻上祭祀。
因為他的亮度和榮耀，我會向他獻上祭祀。
值得被聽見，也就是，對於可怕的瓦尤，誰高度工作....

segments.orig:
(hôrmezd i hvadâe i awazûnî mardum
mardum sardagã hamâ sardagã ham bâ ýasht
i vahã vaem vahe dîn i mâzdayasnã âgâhî
âstvãnî nêkî rasãnât
êduñ bât,)
segments.en:
Yatha ahu vairyo: The will of the Lord is the law of holiness....
I bless the sacrifice and invocation unto, and the strength and
vigour of Rama Hvastra, and Vayu, who works highly, more powerful
to amict than all the other creatures: this part of thee that
belongs to the Good Spirit.
Ashem Vohu: Holiness is the best of all good....
[Give] unto that man brightness and glory, .... give him the bright,
all-happy, blissful abode of the holy Ones.
segments.zh: 亞沙阿胡瓦伊羅：主的意志是神聖的法律.... 我祝福祭祀和呼喚，以及拉瑪·哈瓦斯特拉的力量與活力，以及瓦尤，他工作極高，對眾生而言比其他所有生物更具力量：這部分屬於你，屬於善靈。 阿舍姆‧沃胡：神聖是一切善事中最好的.... 〔Give〕給予那人光明與榮耀，.... 給予他光明、全然幸福、福樂的聖者居所。
